title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Location History
description: Location history data in DS1 may be accessed by unauthorized parties if access controls are insufficient, leading to disclosure of sensitive location information.
assumptions: Assumes DS1 lacks robust access control mechanisms or encryption at rest.
uncertainty_note: Node Dd.1.1 is approximate; exact LINDDUN Pro node for storage access controls may vary.

title: Lack of Audit Logging for Location Data Retrieval
description: P1 does not log retrieval of location history, making it difficult to detect unauthorized access or misuse of the data.
assumptions: Assumes P1 does not implement audit trails for data access events.
uncertainty_note: Node D.1.1 is approximate; exact LINDDUN Pro node for audit logging may differ.
